Name: Vertical Farming
Author: Aufhcegak
Description:
[b]PC 0.6.5 — research pacing and usability update / 科研节奏与界面更新[/b]

小麦、南瓜、蓝莓、上古水果四项课题，完成真实试种并达到观察要求后，可当天在研究桌登记。观察跨日与重载保留，升级保留旧已交材料与有效末阶段观察。包含0.6.4十二项审查修复；其余研究、种植架配方与产量未在0.6.5中调整。

Wheat, Pumpkin, Blueberry and Ancient Fruit studies can now be registered on the day their real trial and observation requirements are met. Observations persist across days and save/load. Eligible old observations and paid materials are retained. Includes the 0.6.4 release-review fixes.

[b]安装 / Install[/b]
本页主文件为完整PC安装包。需要Stardew Valley 1.6与[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.0.0+[/url]；已在Windows 1.6.15 / SMAPI 4.5.1验证。关闭游戏并备份存档，将包内VerticalFarming文件夹完整替换到Mods，保留自己的config.json，然后重启。英文与中文均内置。

Download the complete PC main file, close the game, back up your save and replace the VerticalFarming folder in Mods while retaining your own config.json. Restart the game. English and Chinese are included. The separate Android build is unchanged by this release.

一格耕地叠到四层。建起农业研究所，研发二至四层种植架，再为39种作物试种。作物任选、可同时研究；种子和肥料按层消耗，收获独立结算。内置中文和英文。

Downloads.Description:
PC full installation, version 0.6.5. Requires Stardew Valley 1.6 and SMAPI 4.0.0+ (tested on Windows 1.6.15 / SMAPI 4.5.1). English and Chinese included.

Wheat, Pumpkin, Blueberry and Ancient Fruit studies now combine observation and registration: complete the real trial and required growth phase, then register that day. Recorded observations and paid materials survive updates. Includes the 0.6.4 fixes to rack identity, mixed seeds, four-layer research, research UI, trial cleanup and cost previews.

Close the game, back up your save, replace the VerticalFarming folder in Mods and retain your own config.json. This is a complete PC package; no older download is required. The separate Android build is unchanged.

0.6.5 PC完整安装包。小麦、南瓜、蓝莓、上古水果四项课题达到真实试种与观察要求后，可当天登记；保留旧已交材料和有效观察。包含0.6.4十二项修复。关闭游戏并备份存档后，将VerticalFarming完整替换到Mods，保留自己的config.json。手机独立版本未更新。
